question: As of January 2021, how many states have the upper house called State Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Six**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **bicameral state legislature** has two houses to make a law namely legislative assemblies and legislative councils(Vidhan Parishad).

 
 
• **As of January 2021, Six states have the upper house called State Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad) in India**__.
 
• States with Legislative Council are:
 __
 
• Andhra Pradesh
 
• Bihar
 
• Karnataka
 
• Maharashtra
 
• Telangana
 
• Uttar Pradesh
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Union Territories like **Delhi, Jammu and Kashmir, and Puducherry** have their own legislative assembly and council of ministers.
 
• **Vidhan Parishads** are also known as Legislative councils.
 
 
• Vidhan Parishads are the upper houses of the provincial legislature in the different states of India.
 
• Vidhan Parishad is analogous to **Rajya Sabha.**
 
• Members of the Vidhan Parishad are indirectly elected and nominated.
 
• The maximum strength of the Vidhan Parishad is fixed at o**ne-third of the total strength of the assembly.**
